values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the **principal normal vector** is $\mathbf{n}:=\dfrac{\gamma''}{\lVert\gamma''\rVert}$, i.e. $\mathbf{n}(s)=\gamma''(s)/\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$. It is a unit vector orthogonal to the tangent vector $\mathbf{t}$, and $\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n}$ span the osculating plane.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**主法向量**定义为 $\mathbf{n}:=\dfrac{\gamma''}{\lVert\gamma''\rVert}$，即 $\mathbf{n}(s)=\gamma''(s)/\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$。它是与切向量 $\mathbf{t}$ 正交的单位向量，且 $\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n}$ 张成密切平面。
